base_rules.title: OAuth Token Leakage Risk
base_rules.description: PRDs specifying third-party integrations must utilize secure OAuth handshakes and cryptographically store tokens; raw keys or secrets must never be passed in query params or plaintext headers.

base_rules.title: Unauthenticated REST Endpoints
base_rules.description: Any endpoint mutating database state, retrieving user profiles, or accessing corporate data must require active authentication (JWT session tokens) and enforce strict RBAC checks.

base_rules.title: Missing Schema Constraints
base_rules.description: PRDs initiating new entities or tables must clearly outline primary/foreign keys, uniqueness constraints, nullability, and database types to prevent data corruption.

base_rules.title: Missing Pagination on Lists
base_rules.description: API endpoints returning collections or search results must implement cursor or offset-based pagination to prevent memory exhaustion on large datasets.

base_rules.title: Missing Input Parameter Validation
base_rules.description: Request payloads mutating database states must define strict parameter constraints, types (e.g. UUID, email format), and length validations to prevent SQL Injection or XSS.

optional_rules.title: Unit Test Specifications Required
optional_rules.description: The specification must detail automated testing requirements, coverage targets, or explicit unit test structures for new endpoints or features.

optional_rules.title: API Documentation Specifications Required
optional_rules.description: Any new service or endpoint must detail raw request/response payloads, return schemas, error statuses, and markdown documentation templates.

optional_rules.title: Caching Strategy Required
optional_rules.description: PRDs introducing heavy DB queries, complex tree walks, or external requests must specify cache behaviors (e.g. Redis, browser caching) to protect server load.
